consequence.statement: The upgrade notes list this only as an added metric, so an operator has nothing to do.

original.statement: A new metric, cilium_identity_cache_timer_trigger_folds, is listed under Added Metrics in the 1.17 upgrade notes.

decision.reason: [ev-1b1b9343e346] lists `cilium_identity_cache_timer_trigger_folds` only under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics", next to other new metrics [ev-8a664283f86e] [ev-1a97b17bde3d].
